from.place: comparison isomorphism for perfect complexes: use the dualizability of a perfect complex in the adjunction calculation

title: Tensor-Hom duality for perfect complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let K be a perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex] in the quasi-coherent derived category D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-derived-category], and let A and B be quasi-coherent complexes on X. Then K is dualizable: there is a dual complex K^\vee and canonical evaluation and coevaluation maps, and the induced derived tensor-Hom maps give natural isomorphisms \operatorname{Hom}_{D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)}(K\mathbin{\otimes^L} A,B) \cong \operatorname{Hom}_{D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)}(A,K^\vee\mathbin{\otimes^L}B) and \operatorname{Hom}_{D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)}(A,K\mathbin{\otimes^L}B) \cong \operatorname{Hom}_{D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)}(K^\vee\mathbin{\otimes^L}A,B). Moreover, for every morphism of schemes g:X'\to X, the derived pullback Lg^*K [def-pc-derived-pullback] is a perfect complex on X' and Lg^*(K^\vee) is a dual of it: the two isomorphisms above hold on X' for the pair (Lg^*K,Lg^*(K^\vee)) and all quasi-coherent complexes A,B on X'.

source.place: Tag 0A9T proof (perfect complexes are dualizable; tensor-Hom adjunction; compatibility of the dual with derived pullback)

proof.text: Define K^\vee globally as R\mathcal Hom(K,\mathcal O_X). By [lem-pc-perfect-rhom-tensor-comparison], K^\vee lies in D_QCoh(O_X), the global evaluation map \epsilon:K^\vee\otimes^L K\to\mathcal O_X and the global coevaluation \eta:\mathcal O_X\to K\otimes^L K^\vee (corresponding to \mathrm{id}_K under K\otimes^L K^\vee\cong R\mathcal Hom(K,K)) satisfy the zig-zag identities, so (K,K^\vee,\epsilon,\eta) is an exact pairing in D_QCoh(O_X). All these maps are defined globally; no gluing of morphisms in the derived category is used.

Apply the tensor-Hom equivalences for an exact dual pair [lem-pc-dualizable-tensor-hom-equivalences] in the monoidal category D_QCoh(O_X), with the globally defined dual pair (K,K^\vee). They give naturally Hom(K\otimes^L A,B) \cong Hom(A,K^\vee\otimes^L B) and Hom(A,K\otimes^L B) \cong Hom(K^\vee\otimes^L A,B) for all quasi-coherent A and B.

Let g:X'\to X. Perfectness of Lg^*K is local on X': on the inverse images of an open cover of X on which K is isomorphic to a strictly perfect complex \mathcal E^\bullet, [lem-pc-flat-complex-derived-pullback] represents Lg^*K by the termwise pullback g^*\mathcal E^\bullet [def-pc-derived-pullback], whose terms are again direct summands of finite free modules (pullback preserves finite free modules and idempotent summands), so Lg^*K is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]; only the isomorphism class of a restriction is checked locally. By [lem-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-qcoh], Lg^*K and Lg^*(K^\vee) lie in D_QCoh(O_{X'}). Applying [lem-pc-perfect-rhom-tensor-comparison] on X' to the perfect complex Lg^*K gives an exact pairing (Lg^*K, R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*K,\mathcal O_{X'})) in D_QCoh(O_{X'}), and the same node gives the global base-change isomorphism Lg^*(K^\vee)\cong R\mathcal Hom(Lg^*K,\mathcal O_{X'}). Transporting the evaluation and coevaluation along this isomorphism makes (Lg^*K,Lg^*(K^\vee)) an exact pairing, i.e. Lg^*(K^\vee) is a dual of Lg^*K.

lean.statement: theorem perfect_tensor_hom_duality (X : Scheme.{u₁}) [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : X.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))] (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X) (hK : Scheme.IsPerfect X K.obj) : ∃ Kdual : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, Nonempty (ExactPairing K.obj Kdual.obj) ∧ Nonempty (ExactPairing Kdual.obj K.obj) ∧ Nonempty (tensorLeft K.obj ⊣ tensorLeft Kdual.obj) ∧ Nonempty (tensorLeft Kdual.obj ⊣ tensorLeft K.obj) ∧ (∀ A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X, schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (K.obj ⊗ A.obj) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty X (Kdual.obj ⊗ A.obj)) ∧ ∀ (T : Scheme.{u₁}) (g : T ⟶ X) [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))] [∀ U : T.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (SheafOfModules.{u₁} ((moduleRings T.toRingedSpace).over U))], Scheme.IsPerfect T ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty T ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty T ((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj) ∧ Nonempty (ExactPairing ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj) ((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj)) ∧ Nonempty (ExactPairing ((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj) ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj)) ∧ Nonempty (tensorLeft ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj) ⊣ tensorLeft ((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj)) ∧ Nonempty (tensorLeft ((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj) ⊣ tensorLeft ((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj)) ∧ ∀ A : schemeDerivedQCohCategory T, schemeDerivedQCohProperty T (((derivedPullback g).obj K.obj) ⊗ A.obj) ∧ schemeDerivedQCohProperty T (((derivedPullback g).obj Kdual.obj) ⊗ A.obj)
lean.note: ExactPairing supplies evaluation, coevaluation and zig-zags; the two tensor adjunctions carry natural Hom equivalences. Ambient Hom sets equal those of the full D_QCoh subcategory, and explicit closure clauses keep every displayed tensor in D_QCoh. The derived monoidal structure is fixed by the new definition, with no arbitrary monoidal hypothesis.
